stories.title: Why Philly? Why not Cleveland or Miami? Here's eve...
stories.summary: LeBron James' decision creates massive questions for the 76ers, Cavaliers and Heat, as well as the legend who -- once again -- has rocked the NBA.

stories.title: Liberty's Jones lifts Team Spoon, wins All-Star MV...
stories.summary: Jonquel Jones earned MVP honors after scoring 22 points and falling two assists shy of a triple-double to help Caitlin Clark and Team Spoon defeat Team Coop 129-122 in the WNBA All-Star Game.

stories.title: Sources: KCP to join 76ers after Grizzlies buyout
stories.summary: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope has agreed to a buyout with the Grizzlies and plans to sign a one-year deal with the 76ers after clearing waivers, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: LeBron decision came down to wire, agent says
stories.summary: Rich Paul called the lead-up to LeBron James' decision to join the Sixers an "emotional roller coaster" that didn't end until early Friday morning.

stories.title: Sources: A's star Langeliers may miss rest of '26
stories.summary: Athletics All-Star catcher Shea Langeliers could miss the remainder of the 2026 season after suffering a torn meniscus in his right knee, sources told ESPN.
